git.note: not run inside a git repository

meta.config:
# 所有參數放這裡。標「初值」的門檻只能在開發集上調，11/2 凍結後另存 configs/frozen.yaml。
seed: 2026

paths:
  raw: data/raw
  catalog: data/catalog.csv
  synthetic: data/synthetic
  extract: work/extract
  features: work/features
  candidates: work/candidates
  verified: work/verified
  models: work/models
  annotations: annotations
  results: results
  reports: reports

data:
  years: [2023, 2024, 2025]        # 報告年度（報告涵蓋的會計年度）
  n_firms: 150
  n_dev: 30                        # 以公司為單位
  dev_must_include: ["1101", "1707"]   # 台泥、葡萄王

extract:
  crop_long_side: 1024
  jpg_quality: 90

photo_filter:
  model: ViT-L-14
  pretrained: openai
  exclude_first_last_page: true
  photo_prompts: ["a photograph of a real scene", "a photograph of people"]
  nonphoto_prompts: ["an illustration", "a chart or infographic", "a logo or icon",
                     "a scanned certificate or document", "an abstract graphic design"]

retrieve:
  global_models: [dinov2_vitb14, sscd_disc_mixup]
  topk: 10
  years_back: [1, 2]               # t 年對 t-1、t-2
  use_flip: true

verify:
  max_keypoints: 2048
  matcher: superpoint_lightglue    # 對照：sift_ratio0.8
  ransac: magsac
  reproj_threshold_px: 8.0         # 初值
  min_inliers: 25                  # 初值
  min_coverage: 0.30               # 初值：內點涵蓋較小那張圖的比例
  min_ssim: 0.60                   # 初值：對齊後重疊區的 SSIM

synthetic:
  n_pos: 2000
  n_neg: 10000
  crop_keep_area: [0.5, 0.9]
  brightness_contrast: 0.30
  saturation: 0.50
  hue_deg: 10
  overlay_text_area: [0.10, 0.30]
  jpeg_quality: [50, 90]
  downscale: [0.5, 0.8]
  collage_area: [0.40, 0.70]

analysis:
  text_sim_max: 0.5                # 兩年旁邊文字相似度低於這個值算「說法換了」；論文要報敏感度
  text_ngram: 3                    # 字元三元組 TF-IDF
  year_cues:
    2023: ["2023", "112年", "112 年"]
    2024: ["2024", "113年", "113 年"]
    2025: ["2025", "114年", "114 年"]

evaluation:
  bootstrap_unit: firm
  bootstrap_n: 2000
  ci: 0.95
